pages.text: The $(l)Gem Helmet$(), also called the $(o)Abyss Helmet$(), is the first piece of the end-game Gem Armor set. Craft it from a Red Matter Helmet, an Evertide Amulet, a Soul Stone and a $(l)fully charged Klein Star Omega$(). In this version the Omega must be full before it can be used in the recipe.$(br2)While worn it slowly heals you, and it can grant Night Vision. Press $(l)Shift + X$() to toggle Night Vision.

$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br)$(li)Heals 1 HP (half a heart) every 10 seconds.$(li)Night Vision lasts as long as the toggle is on. Turning it off only removes the helmet's own Night Vision, never one from a potion or beacon.$(li)The whole Gem set reduces damage by roughly 63% and each piece blocks a flat amount per hit.$(li)$(l)R$() (with an empty hand and the offensive state on) calls down lightning where you look, up to 120 blocks away. Offensive abilities are disabled by default.
